extName.message: Sotto – Volume Booster & Tab Volume Control
extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the store.

extDescription.message: Volume booster and per-tab volume control: up to 500% without distortion, plus mono, night mode and balance. Lets go when done.

limiterHintOn.message: Limiter on: keeps boosted sound from distorting. While it's lit, turning up further compresses the sound instead of making it louder. Click to turn it off.

limiterHintOff.message: Limiter off: loud parts of boosted sound will clip and crackle, for every tab. Click to turn it back on.

statusIdle.description: Sotto is not doing anything to this tab.

statusActive.description: Sotto is processing this tab's audio.

monoHint.message: Mono audio: play both channels in both ears (fixes one-sided sound)

nightHint.message: Night mode: tames loud effects and brings dialogue forward

resetHint.message: Back to defaults: 100%, stereo, night mode off, balance centred

releaseHint.message: Turn Sotto off for this tab. Its sound goes back to exactly how it was.

noticeRestricted.message: The browser doesn't allow controlling audio on this page.

noticeFailed.message: Couldn't take control of this tab. Reload the page and try again.

commandRelease.message: Turn off for the current tab
